description.default: Comment on any text: threads live in the right dock, ordered by where the quoted text appears. Replies (and replies to replies), editing and deleting, per-thread resolve-and-hide, click-to-jump with a pulse on the underlined sentence.
description.zh-CN: 选中文字即可评论：评论排在右侧面板，按引用文字在文档中的位置排列；支持回复、对回复再回复（显示「回复 @某人」）、编辑与删除、整条评论「解决并隐藏」，点评论即可跳转到对应句子并在下划线处闪烁提示。
